constraints.name: no_self_loop
constraints.description: No station is connected to itself; xi ≠ yi.

constraints.name: no_multiple_edges
constraints.description: Between each pair of stations there is at most one passage.

constraints.name: undirected_graph
constraints.description: Passages can be used to travel in both directions; the graph is undirected.

constraints.name: graph_connectivity
constraints.description: One can reach any station from any other station along the passages.

constraints.name: exactly_one_cycle
constraints.description: The subway scheme contains exactly one simple cycle (ringroad) that does not repeat any station.
